name: List All Inventories
description: Returns all inventory items that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter inventory items last updated at or after this date-time.

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the inventory item

responseFields.name: data[].Name
responseFields.description: The name of the inventory item

responseFields.name: data[].Quantity
responseFields.description: The current quantity of the inventory item

responseFields.name: data[].Reorder
responseFields.description: The quantity threshold at which the inventory item should be reordered

responseFields.name: data[].Cost
responseFields.description: The dollar amount cost of the inventory item

responseFields.name: data[].Description
responseFields.description: A brief summary or description of the inventory item

responseFields.name: data[].PartNumber
responseFields.description: The part number of the inventory item

responseFields.name: data[].Shelf
responseFields.description: The shelf or bin location where the inventory item is stored

responseFields.name: data[].Category
responseFields.description: The category of the inventory item

responseFields.name: data[].HiddenAt
responseFields.description: The date and time the inventory item was hidden. Null if the item is not hidden.

responseFields.name: data[].LocationId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the inventory location associated with the inventory item

responseFields.name: data[].VendorId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the vendor associated with the inventory item

responseFields.name: data[].GlAccountId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the general ledger account associated with the inventory item

responseFields.name: data[].MarkUpType
responseFields.description: The type of markup applied to the inventory item. Valid values are Percentage or Fixed Amount.

responseFields.name: data[].MarkUp
responseFields.description: The markup value applied to the inventory item

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The date and time the inventory item was last updated

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
